text:
sara_ops: Heads-up — Q2 planning for spot GPU procurement. Need a default policy for the autoscaler: capacity-optimized vs price-optimized, sensible max-bid defaults, region/instance-type fallbacks, and how much warm on-demand reserve to keep. Cost target for batch training: ~45% of on-demand; inference pools need much lower eviction risk. Any quick proposals?

miguel_infra: +1 we should treat training and inference differently. Training -> aggressive spot (capacity-optimized + diversified instance types). Inference -> small spot mix but keep >=10% on-demand warm pool per region.

ellie_sre: Agree. Also call out interruption handling: rely on the 2-min AWS IMDS spot-notice for graceful checkpointing; ensure controllers subscribe to the SIGTERM/metadata and drain before reprovision. For GCP preemptibles we can't rely on a long notice, so fall back to higher on-demand fraction in those regions.

kai_cost: From cost side: use capacity-optimized allocation strategy, but set max-price = on-demand for safety (we've hit weird price spikes when setting a low cap). Alternatively leave max-price unset (default) but enforce budget alerts. We should measure interruptions per 1k instance-hours per region and adjust.

miguel_infra: Proposed autoscaler snippet (ASG/Spot Fleet style):
```yaml
mixedInstancesPolicy:
  instancesDistribution:
    onDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity: 10
    spotAllocationStrategy: "capacityOptimized"
  launchTemplateOverrides:
    - instanceType: g5.2xlarge
    - instanceType: p4d.24xlarge
    - instanceType: g5.8xlarge
```
This gives diversified types and keeps 10% on-demand.

sara_ops: That looks good. For regions: prefer us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 ordering. If spot capacity is low across preferred types, autoscaler should broaden to secondary instance families (similar VRAM) before failing over regions. Document this in the deploy playbook.

ellie_sre: Ops notes: pre-pull container images into warm nodes and maintain an image cache on local NVMe. When we see an interruption, we should mark the AZ as degraded and temporarily increase on-demand % for that AZ for 30m. Also emit an alert if interruptions > 1% over a 24h sliding window.

spot-bot: [auto] spot-interruption-rate/us-west-2:g5 -> 0.9% (24h), p4d -> 0.3% (24h).

kai_cost: Decision suggestion: default policy = capacity-optimized + diversified overrides; max-price = on-demand; on-demand warm pool = 10% per region for inference-critical pools, 5% for training pools; monitor interruption rate and bump reserve if >1% for 24h. Cost guardrails: alert when realized cost >50% of on-demand or when interruptions cause >15% job failure rate.

miguel_infra: Implementation tasks: 1) update autoscaler template (will send PR), 2) add region ordering & fallback logic to fleet controller, 3) implement image warm pool + cache, 4) add interruption SLO dashboards.

sara_ops: Sounds good. I'm happy to greenlight those defaults for Q2. Post the PRs and I'll approve. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ellie_sre: I'll add a short runbook for graceful shutdown handlers and the AZ-degraded procedure.

spot-bot: [auto] created ticket INFRA-4823: "spot procurement defaults + warm pools" assigned to miguel_infra, ellie_sre, kai_cost.
